points.statement: The aim is to build an embodied agent system centered on a large language model.
points.quote: Building an embodied agent system with a large language model (LLM) as its core is a promising direction.

points.statement: Starting from a basic language model, they add visual processing and an action code library trained on collected high-quality data.
points.quote: We begin our exploration with a vanilla large language model, augmenting it with a vision encoder and an action codebase trained on our collected high-quality dataset STEVE-21K.

points.statement: They then add an evaluation component and memory, turning the model into a more complex system.
points.quote: Subsequently, we enhanced it with a Critic and memory to transform it into a complex system.

points.statement: They finally build a multi-level system made of multiple cooperating agents.
points.quote: Finally, we constructed a hierarchical multi-agent system.

points.statement: Recent work explores how to shrink the agent system by transferring knowledge from a larger model.
points.quote: Our recent work explored how to prune the agent system through knowledge distillation.

points.statement: Collected data supports training multimodal language models with visual-environment, question-answer, and skill-code pairs to improve interaction and task execution.
points.quote: The STEVE-21K dataset is integral for training the multi-modal Large Language Models (LLMs) in the STEVE Series, containing 600 Vision-Environment pairs, 20,000 Question-Answering pairs, and 210 Skill-Code pairs to enhance agents’ interaction and task execution in Minecraft.

points.statement: The simulation environment uses dedicated interfaces to provide a realistic setting for high-fidelity agent performance.
points.quote: Our simulation environment utilizes MineDojo (fan2022minedojo) and Mineflayer (mineflayer) APIs, providing a realistic setting for high-fidelity agent performance.

points.statement: Progress comes from integrating multimodal language models, which are essential for improving agent interactions in the environment.
points.quote: The STEVE Series advances through the integration of Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLMs), essential for enhancing agent interactions within Minecraft.

points.statement: Each version progressively improves the agents’ ability to process multiple modalities by incorporating advanced visual models.
points.quote: From STEVE-1 (steve1), using the fine-tuned STEVE-13B model, to STEVE-2 (steve2) which incorporates advanced visual models like LLaVA (liu2023llava; liu2023improvedllava), each version progressively enhances the agents’ multimodal processing abilities.

points.statement: The hierarchical multi-agent system aims to improve cooperation on complex navigation and creation tasks.
points.quote: Introduced in STEVE-1.5, our Hierarchical Multi-Agent System enhances multi-agent cooperation for complex navigation and creation tasks in Minecraft.

points.statement: The system combines central planning with decentralized execution, letting agents adapt strategies and improve environmental interaction.
points.quote: This system supports centralized planning and decentralized execution, enabling agents to adjust strategies and dynamically improve interaction with the environment.

points.statement: The process adds an additional expert to give the teacher model prior knowledge, improving training for complex tasks.
points.quote: This process incorporates the extra expert to enhance the teacher model with prior knowledge, significantly improving training quality for complex tasks.
points.section: 5 Distill Embodied Agent into a Single Model

points.statement: Distilling abilities into one model yields simpler operation and better performance for autonomous agent capabilities.
points.quote: By distilling capabilities into a single model, STEVE-2 (steve2) achieves operational simplicity and superior performance, setting a new benchmark in autonomous agent capabilities within Minecraft.
